preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix must be a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All rows in the matrix must have the same length.
The dimensions of the matrix must be within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the shortest path length.
The return value must be at least -1, indicating no path or a valid path length.
If a path exists, its length must be at least the number of rows.
